headline.purpose: The immediate task inside a grouped action container.

title.purpose: Application chrome and high-priority interface labels.

label.purpose: Field labels, metadata, privacy markers, and progress captions.

shadows.name: grouped-container
shadows.purpose: Grounds the main grouped action container against system black.

shadows.name: app-icon-glow
shadows.purpose: A restrained blue ambient glow reserved for the authentication app icon.

motion.name: verification-pulse
motion.purpose: Signals active link verification without moving layout.

motion.name: reduced-motion-verification
motion.purpose: Removes the working-seal pulse when reduced motion is requested.

components.name: Authentication Header
components.description: Translucent iOS chrome with product title and a quiet privacy marker.
components.html: Calorie TrackerPrivate
components.css: .ds-auth-header { min-height: 3.25rem; padding: 0 max(.8rem, env(safe-area-inset-right)) 0 max(1rem, env(safe-area-inset-left)); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 1rem; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--separator); background: rgba(0, 0, 0, .78); color: var(--label); backdrop-filter: saturate(180%) blur(22px); font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', 'Helvetica Neue', sans-serif; } .ds-auth-header strong { font-size: 1.06rem; font-weight: 650; letter-spacing: -.02em; } .ds-auth-header span { min-height: 2.75rem; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: .32rem; color: var(--secondary-label); font-size: .8rem; font-weight: 550; } .ds-auth-header svg { width: .9rem; height: .9rem; }

components.name: Authentication Progress
components.description: Persistent Email, Verify, Setup progress with text-supported complete, current, and upcoming states.
components.css: .ds-auth-progress { margin: 0; padding: 0; display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: .45rem; list-style: none; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', 'Helvetica Neue', sans-serif; } .ds-auth-progress li { display: grid; gap: .42rem; color: var(--tertiary-label); font-size: .75rem; text-align: center; } .ds-auth-progress i { width: 100%; height: .24rem; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--tertiary-background, #2c2c2e); } .ds-auth-progress li[data-state=complete] { color: var(--secondary-label); } .ds-auth-progress li[data-state=complete] i { background: var(--secondary-label); } .ds-auth-progress li[data-state=current] { color: var(--label); font-weight: 650; } .ds-auth-progress li[data-state=current] i { background: var(--tint); }

components.name: Grouped Action Container
components.description: The single grouped surface that contains one authentication task.
components.html:
Sign in with your email.

We will send a one-time link. It expires in 15 minutes.
components.css: .ds-action-card { padding: 1.25rem; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, .055); border-radius: 1.45rem; background: var(--secondary-background); color: var(--label); box-shadow: 0 1.4rem 4rem -2rem rgba(0, 0, 0, .78); font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', 'Helvetica Neue', sans-serif; } .ds-action-card h2 { max-width: 16ch; margin: 0; font-size: clamp(1.75rem, 7.5vw, 2.2rem); font-weight: 720; letter-spacing: -.035em; line-height: 1.08; } .ds-action-card p { max-width: 31rem; margin: .65rem 0 0; color: var(--secondary-label); font-size: .98rem; line-height: 1.48; }

components.name: Email Field
components.description: Large stacked-label email field with an inset blue focus treatment.
components.css: .ds-email-field { min-height: 3.75rem; padding: .72rem .9rem; display: grid; align-content: center; border-radius: .8rem; background: var(--tertiary-background); color: var(--label); font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', 'Helvetica Neue', sans-serif; } .ds-email-field:focus-within { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px var(--tint), 0 0 0 3px #000, 0 0 0 6px var(--tint); } .ds-email-field span { margin-bottom: .15rem; color: var(--secondary-label); font-size: .78rem; font-weight: 500; } .ds-email-field input { width: 100%; padding: 0; border: 0; outline: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--label); font: inherit; font-size: 1.05rem; } .ds-email-field input::placeholder { color: var(--tertiary-label); }

components.name: Primary Action
components.description: Full-width blue action for the next decisive authentication step.
components.html: <button class="ds-primary-action">Email me a sign-in link<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m9 18 6-6-6-6m6 6H4" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-primary-action { width: 100%; min-height: 3.15rem; padding: 0 1rem; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: .55rem; border: 0; border-radius: .85rem; background: var(--tint); color: #fff; box-shadow: none; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', 'Helvetica Neue', sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 650; letter-spacing: -.015em; } .ds-primary-action:hover, .ds-primary-action:active { background: var(--tint-pressed, #409cff); } .ds-primary-action:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--tint); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-primary-action:disabled { background: #3a3a3c; color: var(--tertiary-label); opacity: 1; } .ds-primary-action svg { width: 1.1rem; height: 1.1rem; }

components.name: Secondary Action
components.description: Clear blue action for resend, sign-out, or low-emphasis recovery.
components.css: .ds-secondary-action { min-height: 2.75rem; padding: 0 .75rem; border: 0; border-radius: .75rem; background: transparent; color: var(--tint); font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', 'Helvetica Neue', sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 650; letter-spacing: -.015em; } .ds-secondary-action:hover, .ds-secondary-action:active { background: rgba(10, 132, 255, .1); color: var(--tint-pressed, #409cff); } .ds-secondary-action:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--tint); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-secondary-action:disabled { color: var(--tertiary-label); opacity: 1; }

components.name: Grouped Detail List
components.description: Inset iOS-style facts with indented separators inside one group.
components.css: .ds-detail-list { margin: 0; overflow: hidden; border-radius: .8rem; background: var(--tertiary-background); color: var(--label); font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', 'Helvetica Neue', sans-serif; } .ds-detail-list div { min-height: 3.15rem; margin-left: .9rem; padding-right: .9rem; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto; align-items: center; gap: 1rem; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--separator); } .ds-detail-list div:last-child { border-bottom: 0; } .ds-detail-list dt { font-size: .94rem; } .ds-detail-list dd { margin: 0; color: var(--secondary-label); font-size: .92rem; font-weight: 500; text-align: right; }

components.name: Error Status
components.description: Text-first failure feedback with an alert icon and recovery context.
components.html:
Verification stopped

This sign-in link has expired. Request a new one.
components.css: .ds-status-error { padding: .9rem; display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto 1fr; gap: .7rem; border-radius: .8rem; background: rgba(255, 69, 58, .14); color: #ff8a83; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', 'Helvetica Neue', sans-serif; } .ds-status-error svg { width: 1.15rem; height: 1.15rem; margin-top: .1rem; } .ds-status-error strong { display: block; font-size: .92rem; } .ds-status-error p { margin: .15rem 0 0; font-size: .86rem; line-height: 1.4; }

components.name: Success Status
components.description: Persistent session confirmation with explicit text and a check icon.
components.html:
Session saved

You will stay signed in here until you sign out on this phone.
components.css: .ds-status-success { padding: .9rem; display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto 1fr; gap: .7rem; border-radius: .8rem; background: rgba(48, 209, 88, .14); color: #63df81; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', 'Helvetica Neue', sans-serif; } .ds-status-success svg { width: 1.15rem; height: 1.15rem; margin-top: .1rem; } .ds-status-success strong { display: block; font-size: .92rem; } .ds-status-success p { margin: .15rem 0 0; font-size: .86rem; line-height: 1.4; }

components.name: Verification Seal States
components.description: Circular working, success, and failure indicators with a reduced-motion-safe pulse.
components.html: ✓!
components.css: .ds-seal-states { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 1rem; } .ds-seal { width: 5.5rem; height: 5.5rem; display: grid; place-items: center; position: relative; border-radius: 50%; background: rgba(10, 132, 255, .14); color: var(--tint); font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', 'Helvetica Neue', sans-serif; font-size: 2rem; font-weight: 700; } .ds-seal::after { position: absolute; inset: .45rem; border: 1px solid currentColor; border-radius: inherit; content: ''; opacity: .32; } .ds-seal-working i { width: 1.8rem; height: 1.8rem; border: 3px solid currentColor; border-right-color: transparent; border-radius: 50%; } .ds-seal-working::after { animation: ds-seal-pulse 1.8s ease-in-out infinite; } .ds-seal-success { background: rgba(48, 209, 88, .14); color: #30d158; } .ds-seal-error { background: rgba(255, 69, 58, .14); color: #ff453a; } @keyframes ds-seal-pulse { 50% { transform: scale(.9); opacity: .12; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-seal-working::after { animation: none; } }

narrative.overview:
Authentication feels native to the device: a true-black environment, dark grouped surfaces, compact system chrome, one blue interaction tint, and direct touch-first controls. The tone is private, factual, and calm rather than promotional.

Email, verification, and setup form one visible sequence. State changes are explicit, semantic colors always carry text and icon support, and the composition remains phone-shaped at larger widths.
keyCharacteristics: True-black canvas with charcoal grouped and inset surfaces.
System typography with compact, high-contrast hierarchy.
One interaction blue, reserved semantic green and red, and no decorative color.
Persistent three-step authentication progress and reduced-motion support.

rules.name: The One Tint Rule
rules.body: Interaction blue is the only non-semantic accent. Pressed blue is a state of that tint, not a second accent.

rules.name: The Semantic Exception Rule
rules.body: Green and red appear only for successful or failed outcomes, always beside text and an icon.

rules.name: The Device Type Rule
rules.body: Use the system stack only; no imported typeface, decorative display face, or all-caps interface copy.

rules.name: The Tonal Depth Rule
rules.body: Grouping comes from black-to-charcoal layers; shadows support only the app icon and grouped action container.

dos: Do keep authentication on true black with grouped charcoal containment.
Do preserve the Email, Verify, Setup sequence and expose its current step to assistive technology.
Do pair progress, success, error, loading, and disabled states with visible text rather than color alone.
Do honor safe areas, text scaling, keyboard focus, reduced motion, and 44pt-or-larger targets.
donts: Don't introduce any accent beyond interaction blue and semantic success or error.
Don't expand authentication into a desktop split layout; preserve the centered one-column mobile boundary.
Don't use shadows as the default separator between grouped content.
Don't hide recovery actions or collapse state feedback into an icon alone.
